Commentary.Commentary: Well, 156 is still a good target to defend but the Aussies will feel they can get them. There is visible dew on the outfield and that might go against the bowlers. Stay tuned for Australia's reply...

Stanlake and Tye then struck 4 times in 2 overs and that just pegged the 'hosts' back. Babar Azam, though, stayed unbeaten on 68. How crucial will that knock be? Earlier, Pakistan were 105/2 in the 14th over but then well, they just played like Pakistan.

41/5 in the final 5 overs - but 17 came in the last. It was a poor final over from Nathan Coulter-Nile but if truth be told, Pakistan have imploded here. They were looking good for a score around 180 but Hafeez' wicket simply changed the momentum.
A good yorker, hit back down the ground for one. 17 from the final over as Pakistan finish on 155/8!
A yorker outside off, squeezed towards point for a run.
A knuckle bouncer, Ali tries to hit it away but misses. The batsmen sneak in a bye.

DROPPED, FOUR! Loose from Australia. First, a full toss from the bowler. Hasan smokes it over his head, but provides a catching opportunity to the fielder at long on. Short races to his left, but his one eye is on the ropes. he puts in a casual attempt for the catch but does not even get close to the ball. IT bursts through his palms and bounces just in front of the ropes.
SIX! Ho ho ho! Told you, this bloke can hit. A short ball, outside off, Hasan camps back in his crease and pulls it way over long on!
INSIDE EDGE, FOUR! Hard luck for Coulter-Nile. He fires in a yorker outside off, Hasan jams his bat down but gets an inside edge. Luckily for him, it scoots past the leg stump to the fine leg fence!
Nathan Coulter-Nile to bowl the final over. 3-0-26-0 so far.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
Full on middle, chipped towards long on for one.
Full and around off, Azam looks to flick but gets a leading edge through the covers. A run taken.
Outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.

NOT OUT. Nothing on the Snickometer. They check for the LBW as well, but the impact was umpore's call while the ball was missing leg. Australia lose their review. Full and down the leg side, Hasan walks across and looks to flick but misses. There is a noise as the ball goes past the bat and Alex Carey, immediately appeals after catching it. However, Andrew Tye turns his back on him. Aaron Finch though, is interested in that appeal and backs his keeper and goes for the review. Snickometer shows a tiny spike when the ball kisses the pad while it never looked LBW in the first place. Superb call from the umpire.
IS THAT A WICKET TOO? Alex Carey reckons he has Hasan Ali caught behind. Aaron Finch takes the review...
Hasan Ali walks in at number 10, replacing Imad. He can tonk a few.
OUT! The procession continues. Wicket number 8 falls. Third for Tye in the space of 4 balls. Full and outside off, Wasim loosely chips it in the air and finds Aaron Finch at short extra cover.
On a length outside off, Babar feels for it but misses. 3 singles and 2 wickets from the over, Stanlake finishes with figures of 4-0-21-3!!!
Imad Wasim is in next, at number 9, replacing Shadab.

OUT! That is the second wicket in the over and 4th in the last 2! A short ball outside off, Shadab looks to pull but the bounce gets big on him. Takes the top edge which goes towards fine leg. Ben McDermott circles to his left and takes it calmly.
Outside off, steered towards third man for one.
Landed outside off, flashed behind point for a run.
Shadab Khan comes in at number 8, replacing his skipper.

OUT! Umpire's call it is when the ball hits the stumps and the decision stays as it is! Australia have three wickets in 4 balls. A length ball, around off, cutting in off the seam, Sarfraz hops across to flick but misses. He is hit right in front of the sticks and Stanlake appeals. The umpire upholds it and Sarfraz reviews it almost instantaneously. Hawk Eye shows the ball to be clipping the top of the bails, so the decision stays!
Sarfraz Ahmed has been adjudged LBW! He has taken the review though...looks out, says Ramiz Raja on air.
A short ball, pulled straight to deep mid-wicket for a single.

ALMOST A HAT-TRICK! A terrific yorker from Tye, outside off, Sarfraz somehow manages to dig it out. The ball rolls off the bottom edge and goes past the stumps. He wants the single but is sent back. What an over from Tye - 5 runs and 2 wickets!
Sarfraz Ahmed, the skipper, comes in at number 7, replacing Ashraf. Can he avert the hat-trick?

OUT! Caught at cover! Tye is on a hat-trick! Full and outside off, Ashraf looks to drive it through the covers but cannot quite keep it down. Ends up chipping it tamely to Glenn Maxwell at short extra cover who seldom drops such dollies.
Faheem Ashraf walks in at number 6, replacing Talat.

OUT! Finch takes a very good catch! Tye gets a wicket at the death. A length ball, on middle, Talat swings hard but perhaps the running a few balls ago has taken the gas out of him. He was panting while playing this shot and hence lacked some power. Miscued it but Aaron Finch at long on, timed his jump to perfection.
Gets well across his stumps and flicks this slower length ball through mid-wicket for another brace. Beautiful running from Pakistan. The stand is worth 20 from 11 balls.
Full and outside off, Talat chips this uppishly, just wide of cover and gets back for a couple.
A short half-tracker, Tye is lucky that is pulled straight to deep square leg for just a single.
Here's Andrew Tye again. 2-0-14-0 so far.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single. 11 from the over.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
A top edge, but safe. Short ball, at the head, BA looks to pull but gets a top edge. Fine leg runs to his right and manages to put his hand out to push the ball back in. Two runs taken.
A short ball outside off, flayed behind point for a run.
Landed outside off, cutting back in, Babar waits for the ball to come to him and dabs it cheekily towards third man for a single.

SIX! CLOUT! Welcome back into the attack, mate! NCN is welcomed back in some style. A short ball, around middle, Azam is ready, expecting this length and pulls it with aplomb over mid-wicket! The stand moves to 10 from 3 balls.
Nathan Coulter-Nile is back. 2-0-15-0 so far.

MISFIELD, FOUR! D'Arcy Short the culprit. Full on middle, Talat flicks it towards widish long on. Short runs across to his left, slides and looks to cover the ball but it slips through his hands and rolls into the fence behind. 7 runs and a wicket from the over. Zampa finishes with figures of 4-0-32-1.
Outside off, played towards point.
Hussain Talat walks in at number 5, replacing Asif.

OUT! Second wicket for Australia in the space of 6 balls! The big-hitting Asif Ali departs cheaply. The skidder from Zampa, Asif goes back to play to a ball he should have been forward to. Looks to flick but misses and is hit right in front of the stumps. Zampa appeals and the umpire raises his finger in a flash. Asif does not even bother reviewing that.
Full and outside off, driven straight back to the bowler.
On middle and leg, flicked away for a single.
Full on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for a couple.
Asif Ali walks in at number 4, replacing Hafeez.

OUT! Hafeez departs, holing out to long on! Bonus wicket for Australia and a big one. Dropped short, turning in, The Professor goes back to pull it over long on but for once, his timing deserts him in this desert. He gets more height than distance and Ben McDermott takes it calmly at the ropes. Misses out on a half century, does Hafeez. Short, of all the people, brakes the 73-run stand.
Pitched outside leg, Hafeez looks to sweep but misses and is hit on the pads. Dot balls are like gold dust for Australia.
The batsman has played it to the point region. They pick up a single.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Outside off, eased through the covers for one.
Full and outside off, hit back to the bowler.
Flatter from Zampa, pulled through mid-wicket for a run.
SIX! Full toss outside off, Hafeez gets his dancing shoes on and smashes it way over long off! 100 UP FOR PAKISTAN! How much can they get in the remaining 7 overs?
The batsman gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads.
A short ball, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Adam Zampa is back on. 2-0-16-0 so far. Finch not allowing any batsman to settle against a bowler.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Insult to injury, although the batsman is different. Azam dances down the track and bludgeons this past the bowler down the ground for a boundary!
DROPPED! Carey misses another one. Short and outside off, the googly again, Hafeez rocks back to cut but gets a thick outside edge. Carey behind is late to get up and fumbles. A single conceded.
Full on middle, flicked away again for one more.
On middle, helped through the leg side for a run.
NEARLY A WICKET FIRST BALL! A short ball outside off, the wrong' un, Hafeez rocks back to cut but gets a thick inside edge which just misses the stumps towards fine leg! A single taken.
Bowler number 6. D'Arcy Short to bowl his left-arm chinaman.
FOUR! That is through! Short and outside off, Azam waits for the ball to come to him and dabs it through third man for a boundary!
Short on middle, pulled straight to mid-wicket for another single.
Comes down the track and heaves it through mid-wicket for one.
WAS THERE A NICK? A short ball outside off, Babar looks to play the upper cut but misses. Carey initially goes up in an appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Nothing much from the bowler either.
Landed outside off, steered towards third man for a run.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Finch changes the pace. Andrew Tye is back on. 1-0-6-0 so far.
MISFIELD FROM MAXWELL. Short and outside off, Azam goes back and cuts it straight to point who fumbles and allows the single. 77/1 at the halfway mark.
The attempted googly, outside off, short in length, punched through the covers for a single.
Arrow straight, on middle, pushed towards long on for one.
Outside off, pushed towards cover for a quick run.

FOUR! How good is that shot? Landed outside off, Hafeez goes back and just opens the face of his bat. Then guides the ball in front of short third man and finds the boundary. The stand moves to 41 from 31 balls.
Full and outside off, pushed towards long off for a single. Moves to 30 from 26 balls.
On middle and leg, helped through the leg side for a run. 12 from that over.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. They pick up a single.

Full on middle, The Professor works it through mid-wicket and immediately calls for two. Nathan Coulter-Nile comes charging in but then slips, due to the soggy outfield. He gets up gingerly but seems to be okay. Two runs taken. Hafeez moves to 20 from 16 balls.
SIX! The first biggie of the night! Is that the shot which will get Pakistan going? Tossed up outside off, Hafeez dances down the track and sends the ball sailing over long on!
Outside off, punched off the back foot for a run.
Short and outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
Ashton Agar is swung around.
Full and outside off, eased through the covers for one.
Way too short, pulled towards long on for a run.
Pushes this through mid on and gets a single.
Full and outside off, the Professor punches it through the covers for a couple.
Full and down the leg side, flicked towards short fine leg for a run.
A short ball, around leg, pulled behind square leg for a couple ot bring up the 50 in the 8th over.
Here comes the other spinner, with a hair band. His name is Adam Zampa.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
A length ball outside off, played straight to point.
IN THE AIR... SAFE! A short ball outside off, Hafeez looks to fend it away but the ball rises steeply, takes the glove and lands almost in the hands of point running in!
Full on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
A short ball, around the rib cage, Hafeez is on his toes to try and tuck it away but misses and is hit on the chest. A quick leg bye taken.
Landed outside off, Azam steers it towards third man for a single.

Full and on middle, Babar comes down the track to flick but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads. The ball rolls towards point and the batsmen take a single. 45/1 in the Powerplay - decent one for both sides.
Full and down the leg side, Babar misses his flick and is hit on the pads.
On middle and leg, flicked away for a single.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Hafeez dances down the track but gets it off the inner half towards short mid-wicket.
On middle and leg, helped through square leg for a single.
FOUR! Short and outside off, Azam rocks back and punches it through point for a boundary!
Spin time. It is Ashton Agar.
On a length outside off, nips back in sharply, Hafeez looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. Coulter-Nile appeals but the umpire straightaway shakes his head. Perhaps going down leg.
FOUR! SWEET! Full and outside off, Hafeez leans and drives it down the ground. No mid off and that is a boundary!
A short ball around off, Hafeez looks to cut but is cramped for room. The ball hits him on his gloves and deflects towards square leg.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
WIDE. Down the leg side, pretty full, Azam misses his flick.
Outside off, punched towards cover.
Mohammad Hafeez comes in at number 3, replacing Zaman.

OUT! There goes the big-hitting Zaman! Stanlake has bounced out Fakhar. A short ball, on middle, the southpaw looks to pull but the ball keeps climbing on him. He gets a top edge which goes straight up in the air. Nathan Coulter-Nile calls for it from short extra cover and takes it calmly. Big wicket for Australia. Zaman was just beginning to go big.
The batsman dances down the track. A spirited effort by the fielder to ensure the ball doesn't cross the line. Good running between the wickets to pick up three runs.
Landed outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.
Top edge! Good ball by the bowler. One run added to the total.
Outside off, played straight to point.
Full and outside off, nicely steered to third man for a single.
Outside off, played straight to point.
On middle and leg, helped towards mid-wicket for a quick single. 11 from that over, Pakistan are up and running.
Outside off, pushed to cover for a quick run.
FOUR! A length ball outside off, Zaman dances down the track and smashes it straight back over the bowler for a boundary!
Landed outside off, steered towards third man for a single.
FOUR! Dropped short, Azam pulls it over mid-wicket and gets a boundary!
Outside off, pushed straight to cover.

TOP EDGE, DROPPED! FOUR! A tough chance for Alex Carey. Coulter-Nile bangs it in shot and Zaman goes for the pull. Gets a top edge behind. Carey leaps but gets only a glove t it. Parries it to the fine leg fence.
The batsman has played it fine down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! On the pads, Azam flicks it through square leg and gets the boundary count ticking for the match.
A full toss outside off, pushed towards mid on.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
That ball has struck the batsman on the thigh pad. The batsmen have run through for a single. Leg bye given by the umpire.
Who will bowl from the other end? It is that tall man who fits the bill. Stanlake.
The batsman plays the pull shot.
On middle and leg, flicked away for a single.
On middle and off, Zaman misses his flick and is hit on the pads.
Outside off, punched through the covers for three.
The ball strikes the batsman very low on the pads The batsmen have run through for a single. The umpire signals a leg bye.
Full and around middle, swinging in, watchfully defended.

Okay then. Time for the game to begin. Oh no! It is pitch dark! The lights have gone off!!! They are slowly coming back on. Hopefully, we should get a start soon. Here we go then. Nathan Coulter-Nile to start off proceedings to Fakhar Zaman. Babar Azam is his partner. The southpaw on strike...
Okay then. Time for the game to begin.
Time for the national anthems. It will be Australia's first, followed by Pakistan's.

TEAM NEWS - Pakistan had already announced their playing XI yesterday, so no surprises to see who is turning up. Australia, on the other hand, are going in with more or less the same side which played UAE. No Mitchell Marsh. Interesting.
TOSS - Time for the spin of the coin. Aaron Finch has called it correctly and AUSTRALIA OPT TO CHASE.

Windies stretching India in Visakhapatnam while Bangladesh toying with Zimbabwe at Chhotagram. Let our planes take a turn and go to Abu Dhabi! After a 2-match Test series which ended, not surprisingly, in favour of Pakistan, we now turn to the format in which they are number 1. Australia are missing a few seniors but as they showed in Zimbabwe, they have plenty to fight for. Hello and a warm welcome to the first of 3 T20Is between Pakistan and Australia.
